description: Preset library — curated to the brands getbased has direct context on (Mitochondriak, Chroma, EMR-Tek). Anything not on this list goes through the AI-powered custom-add flow (paste URL or scan label) which extracts specs via the user's Claude provider. Each preset maps to a channel-specific dose profile so deviceSessions feed the same accumulators as outdoor solar sessions. catalogSlug links to data/recommendations.json `_internal.lightDevices` for the affiliate-link surface on each device card.

presets.notes: Handheld torch (12.5 cm wand). 5 wavelengths incl. blue 460 nm. Manufacturer quotes >230 mW/cm² @ 1 cm; ~50 at 15 cm working distance. Targeted PBM — small illuminated area.
Screw-in 12×12 cm bulb with holder. 56 W. Targeted PBM — small illuminated area.
32×22 cm portable panel — quarter-body coverage. 210 W. Includes long-NIR 940 nm.
Stationary quarter-body panel for desk/office use. 310 W. Manufacturer quotes >60 mW/cm² @ 30 cm; ~120 at 15 cm (near-field 2×).
15×23 cm portable panel with UVA 360/366 nm on top of red+NIR. No UVB. 36 W. Manufacturer quotes >12 mW/cm² @ 30 cm; ~24 at 15 cm (near-field 2×).
90×30 cm half-body panel. 900 W. Same form factor as the Maxi UVB but red+NIR only — no UV. Manufacturer quotes >105 mW/cm² @ 30 cm; ~210 at 15 cm (near-field 2×).

Czech 90×30 cm broad-spectrum panel. UVB 295 nm + UVA 380 nm + blue 480 nm + red 630/670 nm + NIR 760/810/830/850 nm. Independent on/off for UV+blue vs red+NIR — touchscreen presets gate which channels fire per session. Half-body coverage.

Three modular modes — Ironforge (red 630/670 + NIR 760/810/850), Lux Vital (cyan 485 + violet 405 + UVA 385 + extended NIR 935/1050), D-Light (narrowband UVB 297 nm). Modes fire independently — adjust the dose if you only run one. Handheld, ~310 W combined.
Full-body red + near-IR therapy panel. 660 nm + 850 nm only — no UV, no blue.
